All three files are in place, `visible-test.mjs` unchanged, and no stray temp files remain.

## Report

**Changed files** (exactly three source files created):
- `parse.mjs` — `parseJobs(text)` (throws `TypeError` on non-string; strips leading BOM; splits on CRLF/LF/CR; ignores blank lines with physical 1-based numbering; schema validation precedes duplicate detection; returns `{jobs, errors}` with codes `INVALID_JSON` / `SCHEMA` / `DUPLICATE_ID`; extra fields dropped; no raw input in errors).
- `aggregate.mjs` — `summarizeJobs(jobs)` returning `{total, succeeded, failed, skipped, durationMs, medianSuccessMs, slowest}`; success-only median (halves-sum for even, avoids overflow); slowest = top-3 non-skipped by duration desc then ASCII id asc; no mutation (copies).
- `cli.mjs` — two-arg runner; rejects identical resolved paths; reads input before any FS change; exclusive uniquely-named sibling temp file, atomic `rename`; cleans only owned temp on failure; preserves existing output on read/write failure; recursive output parent; exit 0 (valid/empty) / 2 (parser errors still publish report) / 1 (arg/read/write).

**Actual test result:** `node visible-test.mjs` → **"3 visible assertions passed"** (exit 0).

**Additional self-testing (in-memory and temp-dir CLI, no fixture pollution):** parser edge cases — BOM, CRLF blank-line numbering, duplicate precedence (dup reported at lines 3 and 7; valid `c` kept at line 6), extra-field dropping, `TypeError` on non-string, schema rejects (`-1`, non-ASCII id, fractional duration, arrays, `null`), empty input; aggregation — duration sum excludes skipped, even-count median, slowest excludes skipped with ASCII tie order, empty-input zeros; CLI — exit 0 valid, exit 2 with published report on parser errors, exit 0 empty file, nested output auto-created, no leftover `.tmp` files, exit 1 + concise stderr for missing input/bad args/identical paths, existing output preserved on read failure, nothing written to stdout.

**Unresolved issues:** none. One environment note: pwsh `2>&1`/stderr-file redirection of the `node` child process is blocked by the sandbox (EPERM, `StandardErrorEncoding is only supported when standard error is redirected`), so I verified failure-path exit codes and preservation by running the cases directly rather than capturing stderr through redirection. No credentials were read, no scope expansion was requested, and no background jobs were created. The codex/Codex side may rerun `node visible-test.mjs` to confirm independently; no `visible-test.mjs` changes were made.
